analysis_steps.goal: Build structure maps and B-field orientation

method.value: B-field from HAWC+ Q,U rotated by 90 deg; structure maps from dust, column density, temperature, integrated line intensity; projected to finer grid with 3-sigma cut

evidence.quote: Next, a 3-$\sigma$ signal-to-noise cut is applied to the data points in the structure map $M(x,y)$.

method.value: Gaussian derivative kernel gradient, kernel = beam/3 (min 3 pixels), phi histogram in 20 bins

evidence.quote: The size of the Gaussian kernels in angular units $\theta_{G}$ is chosen to be one third of the FWHM angular resolution

method.value: Projected Rayleigh Statistic corrected by sigma from 1000 white-noise maps; |Zx|>3 significant

evidence.quote: a magnitude of $\lvert Z_{x} \rvert > 3$ is considered statistically significant

validation.value: Monte Carlo of measurement errors gives sigma Zx ~0.2-0.3

evidence.quote: In all cases, $Z_{x}$  $Z^{\prime}_{x}$, and $\Tilde{Z}^{\prime}_{x}$ have standard deviations less than 1.

method.value: 1 km/s slabs stepped by 0.5 km/s, PRS per slab

findings_qualitative.value: ALMA continuum shows no significant alignment preference, likely due to resolved-out large scales and few points above 3 sigma

evidence.quote: The ALMA continuum maps show no significant preference for either parallel or perpendicular alignment.

claims.hypothesis: Do dense-gas and PDR structures align differently relative to the field?
claims.experiment: HRO with HAWC+ field vs 20 tracers
claims.result: Dense tracers negative Zx; Spitzer and [CII] positive or ~0
claims.finding: Bimodal alignment: dense gas perpendicular, PDR parallel

evidence.quote: structures observed with dense gas tracers show a statistically significant preference for perpendicular alignment relative to the magnetic field

claims.hypothesis: Is the alignment bimodality also kinematic?
claims.result: Perpendicular at 4-7 km/s, parallel at 8-11 km/s
claims.finding: Dense and PDR structures are kinematically distinct

evidence.quote: structures associated with the PDR show a preference for parallel alignment at velocities of 8–11 km/s

limitations_admitted.value: ALMA continuum resolves out large structures and HAWC+ may not probe the dense cores

evidence.quote: The HAWC+ Band C data is also likely not probing the magnetic field within the dense cores detected by ALMA

referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA plays a minor role and its HRO result is null
Interpretation relies on plane-of-sky field only
